title: You Parasite (Digital Circus)
blurb: Two words, spat out, and one of the more satisfying insults to come out of The Amazing Digital Circus. Part of the show's appeal is how bluntly its characters speak to one another — there is no polite veneer left after however many years trapped inside the circus — and short venomous lines like this travel well precisely because they need no context at all. It became a stock reply across TikTok edits and Discord soundboards within weeks. Deploy on anyone who takes the last slice without asking.
origin: A line from The Amazing Digital Circus (Glitch Productions).
